fusions.name: Headsman's Reach
fusions.desc: Drops a bladed tip on an enemy at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away, which deals 24 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Felling Arc
fusions.desc: Swings the bladed tip in a full circle that deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to the enemies within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Honed Edge
fusions.desc: Edges the tip of your lash: your critical hits deal 30% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rope-Dart Bit
fusions.desc: Conjures a lash with a bladed head for a tip: your weapon damage rises by 14%, your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
